title: A Closer Look at Bias and Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness of Large (Vision) Language Models
reasoning: The term 'faithfulness' in this paper refers to a technical concept in machine learning interpretability (how well a chain-of-thought reflects a model's internal process), not religious faith. While the paper evaluates biases, its primary focus is on the fidelity of reasoning traces and mechanistic interpretability rather than benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical systems.
